messages:
zoe: quick sync: runtime team wants to propose a 'bonding' phase between control-plane claim and actual model binding for hosted/dedicated/private. purpose: reduce noisy evictions when models are large and boot time is non-trivial.
carlos: clarify: bonding = runtime accepts claim but defers heavy model load until a second confirm? what's the exact lifecycle?
mina: thinking: three phases: RESERVED (claim issued), BONDED (runtime has pinned resources & warmed model), ATTACHED (serving live requests). Transitions: RESERVED->BONDED when runtime loads model; BONDED->ATTACHED when health probe passes.
zoe: defaults: hosted: reserved_ttl=90s, bond_timeout=45s, attach_grace=120s. dedicated: reserved_ttl=30s, bond_timeout=15s. private: reserved_ttl=300s, bond_timeout=120s. These are starting numbers.
carlos: how does eviction work mid-bond? If control plane needs capacity, can it cancel a RESERVED claim? yes but we should surface reason. propose header and stream event: X-RW-Bond-State: RESERVED|BONDED|ATTACHED|CANCELLED and X-RW-Bond-Reason: PREEMPT|AUTHZ|OP_RESTART. For streams use final event {"event":"bond_cancelled","reason":"PREEMPT","when":1933333599}.
mina: token surface: claim_token must include pin (model@sha), bond_allowed=true, and a bond_id. example JWT snippet in message: `{"sub":"rt-7","pin":"model-llama@sha256:abcd","bond_id":"b-123","mode":"hosted","exp":1933334199}`. No wildcards for pin.
zoe: private mode: allow delegated bond issuance by customer control plane. token must include issuer URL and x5c for signature if delegating. runtime verifies issuer chain against configured roots.
carlos: what stays warm on CANCELLED? proposal: if cancel reason=PREEMPT -> BEST_EFFORT preserve model cache for short TTL (e.g., 5m) to allow hot-reattach for same tenant; if reason=AUTHZ/COMPROMISE -> immediate purge. add cache_action field.
mina: also add a soft-resume hook: if a new claim for same tenant arrives within hot_reattach_window, runtime can resume BONDED state w/o full reload. hot_reattach_window default 300s hosted/600s private. This cuts cost on short preempts.
zoe: SDK behavior: while RESERVED, SDK should treat runtime as 'warming' and route new requests elsewhere (429 + Retry-After). When BONDED but not ATTACHED, allow polling-based requests but not long-lived streams. Provide clear error code LeaseState.WARMING.
carlos: metrics: bond_transition_latency_ms{from,to,mode}, bond_cancel_total{reason,mode}, hot_reattach_hits_total{mode,tenant}. alert if bond_failure_rate > 0.1% p5 across region.
mina: control-plane must support preempt-with-grace: send CANCELLED with cache_action=async_invalidate and a cache_job_id to poll. For private where control-plane can't reach runtime, runtime writes /var/lib/redwood/bond-journal and POSTs on reconnection.
zoe: security: bond tokens short-lived; require token rotation policy. recommend control-plane rotate signing key every 30d and allow 2-hour leeway for clock skew. Document verification algorithm.
carlos: eviction priority when choosing bonds to cancel: prefer (non-enterprise SLA, low tenant_weight, recent_bond_age). allow billing-tag override `bond_evict_priority`. Deterministic tie-breaker: hash(bond_id).
mina: wire compactness: prefer small enum headers for high-throughput (single-byte values encoded base64 in X-RW-Bond-State) with manifest describing mapping. For debugging we still ship verbose JSON on /_internal/bond/{id}.
ops-bot: deploy: bond-protocol v1 queued for canary on 2026-03-30T05:00Z.
zoe: rollout plan: probe-first in hosted/dedicated, optimistic in private. Gradual flip: start with monitoring-only (control-plane will annotate decisions but not cancel bonds), then 10% cancellation, then full.
carlos: add SDK migration notes: expose BondStatus API and furnish Retry-After semantics + LeaseState.WARMING error kind.
mina: one more: tie bonding to model-variant pinning. Bond token should include allowed_fallbacks list. runtime must NOT swap model outside allowed_fallbacks. Example claim token field: "allowed_fallbacks":["model-llama:v2","model-llama:quantized-v2"].
zoe: I'll draft RFC with these phases, default numbers, wire headers, token schema, cache actions, and rollout checklist. Reviewers: @carlos @mina @ops-bot.
carlos: I'll add test harness cases for hot_reattach race and for bond cancellation under load.
mina: I'll write the cache-invalidation job API sketch and local journal format.
zoe: thanks all. opening RFC PR now. :rocket:
